findings.description: Preliminary permits refiled to convert 2536 California Street, an 1876 Italianate built by contractor J. Santos as one of a row of single-family dwellings, into two for-sale homes, adding a fourth floor and roof deck behind a largely retained facade; RG Architecture designs, Urban West Construction builds, SB 330 and Housing Choice SF. A 2018 historic resource evaluation found it ineligible for the California Register for low integrity.

citation.label: San Francisco YIMBY, “Preliminary Permits Invoke HC-SF For 2536 California Street, San Francisco,” 18 November 2026

raw.text: The structure was built in 1876 by contractor J. Santos as part of a row of single-family Italianate dwellings.
